system.description:
Guides and scouts who take others where they could not go alone: the Wardens of the Wilds on Tariel's roads and passes, caravan scouts, and the Totem Pathfinders of Treaty Hold.

  • Trailblazer: from 2nd level, creatures that follow your path ignore the extra movement cost of difficult terrain too, and in natural terrain you and your companions can forage or track at normal pace.
    • 9th level: Find Passage works in any terrain, underground and in ruins included.
  • Eyes Ahead: Advantage on initiative rolls in natural terrain.
